our_title: Graph builders free the vertex array on OOM but keep it in a GRAPHFREETABS graph: double free on graphExit
ran:
Plain build of base-combined, LD_PRELOAD injector ($WORK/repro/tools), drivers in $WORK/repro/PS2-G26-1 linked with -lscotcherr (non-exiting):
  FAILMALLOC_FUNC=_SCOTCHmemAllocGroup FAILMALLOC_NTH=2 ./gload_fail s data/bump.grf -> ERROR: graphLoad: out of memory / double free or corruption (top) [abort 134]
  ... ./gload_fail c bump.chac (SCOTCH_graphGeomLoadChac + SCOTCH_graphExit) -> ERROR: graphGeomLoadChac: out of memory / free(): invalid pointer [134]
  FAILMALLOC_FUNC=_SCOTCHmeshGraphDual FAILMALLOC_NTH=2 ../CLI-05/pm_plain 1 (METIS_PartMeshDual) -> ERROR: meshGraphDual: out of memory (1) / ERROR: SCOTCH_METIS_PartMeshDual: cannot build dual graph / free(): double free detected in tcache 2 [134]
  FAILMALLOC_FUNC=_SCOTCHmeshGraphNodal FAILMALLOC_NTH=2 ./mnodal_pristine (SCOTCH_meshGraph + graphExit, base-combined mesh_graph.o interposed) -> free(): double free detected [134]
  patched library: all four return 1 and graphExit() completes ('done', exit 0). The shipped tools (gtst, gcv) hide it because they link -lscotcherrexit. check_libmetis_*, check_libesmumps, check_libparmetis_v3, check_prog_dgord pass in both trees with the patch.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/mesh_graph.c:261-266 (meshGraphDual) and :116-121 (meshGraphNodal); src/libscotch/graph_io.c:165-172 (graphLoad, which even calls graphFree() itself right after the memFree); src/libscotch/graph_io_chac.c:143-149 (graphGeomLoadChac)
evidence:
mesh_graph.c:252 `grafptr->flagval = GRAPHFREETABS | GRAPHVERTGROUP | GRAPHEDGEGROUP;` then :263-266 `errorPrint ("meshGraphDual: out of memory (1)"); if (grafptr->verttax != NULL) memFree (grafptr->verttax); return (1);` -- verttax kept; graph.c:125-131 graphFree: `if ((grafptr->flagval & GRAPHFREEVERT) != 0) { ... if (grafptr->verttax != NULL) memFree (grafptr->verttax + grafptr->baseval);`
graph_io.c:168-171 `if (grafptr->verttax != NULL) memFree (grafptr->verttax); errorPrint ("graphLoad: out of memory"); graphFree (grafptr);`
Precedent of the correct pattern in the same tree: graph_io_habo.c:193-196 and mesh_io_habo.c:176-179 `memFree (grafptr->verttax); grafptr->verttax = NULL;`

fix_options.label: Reset the freed pointer to NULL (chosen)
fix_options.summary: Four sites: `memFree (verttax); grafptr->verttax = NULL;` and, in graphLoad, drop the now double `graphFree()` call (nothing else is allocated at that point).
fix_options.tested: see ran; full check subsets in both trees.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Exactly what he did in graphGeomLoadHabo()/meshGeomLoadHabo() (combined series 04aeb13/275398c keep that form).

fix_options.label: Set the free flags only after the arrays are allocated
fix_options.summary: Initialize flagval to GRAPHNONE and set GRAPHFREETABS|... after both allocations succeed (mesh_graph.c only).
fix_options.tradeoffs: Touches the field assignment order of two routines and does not fit the loaders (graphLoad frees through graphFree on later errors).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Less uniform than the habo precedent.

our_title: Strategy parser: flex buffer allocation failure calls exit(2) from inside the library
ran: Seen while sweeping CLI-10 (plain build, $WORK/repro/CLI-10/es_fail with FAILMALLOC_AT=12..15): 'out of dynamic memory in yy_scan_bytes()' / 'yy_scan_buffer()' / 'yyensure_buffer_stack()', process exit code 2 without any errorPrint; same with the shipped test_esmumps (FAILMALLOC_AT=14..17, exit=2). Not patched.
read_only: The flex-generated src/libscotch/parser_ll.c calls YY_FATAL_ERROR -> yy_fatal_error -> exit(2) on allocation failure (standard flex skeleton); other libscotch OOM paths return an error through errorPrint.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/parser_ll.c (generated from parser_ll.l; yy_scan_bytes / yy_scan_buffer / yyensure_buffer_stack), reached from stratParserParse() for any strategy string
evidence: Program output: 'out of dynamic memory in yy_scan_bytes()' then exit status 2 (flex's yy_fatal_error).

fix_options.label: Override YY_FATAL_ERROR in parser_ll.l to errorPrint + longjmp/return
fix_options.summary: Define YY_FATAL_ERROR(msg) in the lexer prologue so that the parser returns an error instead of exiting; needs a design decision on how to unwind from inside yylex.
fix_options.tested: untested: not written (design decision for the maintainer: flex offers no non-exiting path from yy_scan_bytes without a custom YY_FATAL_ERROR).
fix_options.tradeoffs: Behaviour change only under OOM; libraries should not exit.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Consistent with his errorPrint-and-return convention; left as a note.

fix_options.label: Leave as is
fix_options.summary: Accept exit on OOM inside the strategy lexer.
